meta.name: The Ladys Companion
meta.description: Hired to find husbands for three wealthy sisters, chaperone Elena Bianda is drawn into a late 19th-century world of love, scandal and comic intrigue.

videos.title: Lesson 1: Never Fall in Love
videos.overview: Chaperone Elena Bianda works to earn the trust of Pedro Mencía's daughters — and his attractive godson. At a high-society ball, things go out of control.

videos.title: Lesson 2: Do Not Tell Lies
videos.overview: Elena tries to support Cristina in the wake of her revelation. Sara shares her secret. A face from the chaperone's past makes an unwelcome appearance.

videos.title: Lesson 3: The Past Is in the Past
videos.overview: Both with ulterior motives, Gabriel and Cristina flirt with each other and confuse Santiago. Elena must confront secrets from her rebellious past.

videos.title: Lesson 4: Ward Off Temptation
videos.overview: After a night of indulgence, Cristina pleads with Elena to talk to Santiago, with unexpected results. Josefina and Esther struggle with their feelings.

videos.title: Lesson 5: Stay True to Your Lady
videos.overview: Elena tries to discourage Santiago's feelings while dealing with a rival chaperone. A betrayal surfaces during a séance. Cristina hears from Eduardo.

videos.title: Lesson 6: Your Desires Come Second
videos.overview: Complications almost expose Cristina's secret, and Elena resorts to asking Angustias for help. Santiago battles with doubts about Cristina.

videos.title: Lesson 7: Maintain Proper Decorum
videos.overview: Elena is stunned when her own mother tries to interfere with the Mencías, while Eduardo's return makes things even more confusing for everyone.

videos.title: Lesson 8: Make Your Lady Happy
videos.overview: After a shocking revelation, the sisters are furious with Elena. A professional opportunity for Santiago prompts Cristina to figure out her feelings.
